scripts.watch: concurrently -n langium,tsc,ext -c magenta,blue,green "pnpm run langium:watch" "tsc -b tsconfig.build.json --watch" "pnpm --filter ./packages/extension run watch"
scripts.build: pnpm run langium:generate && pnpm run physics:generate && tsc -b tsconfig.build.json && pnpm -r run build && pnpm run sync:cursor
scripts.build:clean: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
scripts.test: pnpm --filter ./packages/language run test && pnpm --filter ./packages/analytical run test && pnpm --filter ./packages/extension run test
scripts.build:readme: pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-root-readme.ts && pnpm exec tsx scripts/generate-npm-package-readmes.ts
